changes.current: the temporal-mode representatives remaining after duplicate suppression are ranked
changes.proposed: For each terminating trajectory, temporal-mode representatives are ranked before applying the mode cap and coordinate-based duplicate suppression. Their ranks are retained for the final score adjustment; surviving representatives are not reranked.
changes.reason: 採用条件は抑制前の順位固定。前後の感度比較は別表とし、新テストで再選択しない。

changes.current: all detections within a spatiotemporal gate around a ground-truth event were treated as positive examples
changes.proposed: Within the candidate set used by each training stage, identity-consistent matches use observed parent IDs at t-1 and daughter IDs at t+1, without imputation. Events without such matches use spatial fallback. Spatially eligible but inconsistent candidates for events with an identity-consistent match have zero loss weight. For Ours, eligibility additionally requires an absolute axial separation of at most 15 mm; the depth-free variants do not use this axial gate. Event and class weights are recomputed for the retained top-20 attention inputs.
changes.reason: gate/H/U/top20の教師集合とneutralを明示し、学習Zゲートと共通評価のnoZを区別する。

changes.proposed: AP is computed as the stepwise integral of the monotonically enveloped precision--recall curve. Predictions with tied scores enter together at each threshold.
changes.reason: 現在の計算はprecision envelopeの積分。scikit-learnの非補間APと同一と説明しない。

changes.current: The test sequence was excluded from feature design, threshold and hyperparameter tuning, and model selection; it was used only for performance evaluation after all settings had been fixed.
changes.proposed: The test sequence was excluded from model fitting. The same seed had previously been used in implementation and sensitivity checks on the earlier generated data. This prior use is disclosed; the settings for the present full evaluation were fixed before examining its results.
changes.reason: 過去のテスト感度分析を消せない。独立な未使用testを主張する場合は追加系列を事前固定して評価する必要がある。

changes.proposed: Comparison of scoring stages under common temporal-mode aggregation, a per-trajectory mode cap, rank adjustment, and localization correction. Coordinate suppression is added only in the last row. A separate control removes all duplicate-suppression operations. The trajectory-only row uses the static shortlist and has no image features for localization; later rows use the scoring union and their available image features. Thus the comparison includes candidate-selection and feature-availability changes.
changes.reason: 現コードの表の行は共通後処理を持つ。段階ごとの改善という記述は実測のclaim-checksで確認する。

changes.current: The particle statistics used to generate the synthetic fields were based on trajectory statistics from the 14 experimental sequences
changes.proposed: The empirical diameter and velocity distributions used for synthetic generation were frozen from the documented earlier processing of the 14 experimental sequences. Subsequent reprocessing of experimental measurements does not retroactively change the synthetic generator inputs.
